mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_application_material_submission (job_application_id, company_application_id, student_id, company_id, submitted_at) VALUES (#{jobApplicationId}, #{companyApplicationId}, #{studentId}, #{companyId}, #{submittedAt})

INSERT INTO job_application_material_file (submission_id, file_type, file_name, file_path, file_size, sort_order) VALUES (#{submissionId}, #{fileType}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM job_application_material_file WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
